title: The Pakhtunkhwa Energy Development Organization Amendment Act 2014

sections.shortTitle: The Pakhtunkhwa Energy Development Organization Amendment Act 2014
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

AN
AN
ACT
further to amend the Pakhtunkhwa Hydel
Development Organization
Act, 1993
Preamble.--- WHEREAS it is expedient further to amend the Pakhtunkhwa Hydel Development
Organization Act, 1993, (Pakhtunkhwa Act No. I of 1993) for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short title and commencement.--- (1) This Act may be called the Pakhtunkhwa Energy Development Organization (Amendment) Act, 2014.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

It is hereby enacted as follows:
2. General amendment.--- In the Pakhtunkhwa Hydel Development Organization Act, 1993 (Pakhtunkhwa Act No. I of 1993), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, for
the words Pakhtunkhwa Hydel
Development Organization , wherever
occurring the words Pakhtunkhwa Energy Development Organization and for the

occurring the words Chief Executive Officer shall respectively be

sections.shortTitle: The Pakhtunkhwa Energy Development Organization Amendment Act 2014
sections.description:
Amendment of section 4 of the Pakhtunkhwa Act No. I of 1993

AN
AN
ACT
further to amend the Pakhtunkhwa Hydel Development
Organization
Act, 1993
Preamble.--- WHEREAS it is expedient further to amend the Pakhtunkhwa Hydel Development Organization Act,
1993, (Pakhtunkhwa Act No. I of 1993)
for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:
4. Amendment of section 4 of the
Pakhtunkhwa Act No. I of 1993.--- In
the said Act, in section 4,
(a) in sub-section (2), clauses (ii), (iv), (ix),
(x) and xi shall be deleted;
(b) in sub-section (2), in clause (xii), after semi
colon ; , the word and appearing
at the end, shall be deleted;
(c) in sub-section (2), the existing clause xiii,
shall be re numbered as (xiv) and a
new clause xiii shall be inserted in
the following manner, namely:
(xiii) four members to be appointed by Government
from amongst reputed professionals,
businessmen and experts from private
sector; and ; and
(d) after sub-section (2), a new sub-section (3)
shall be added in the following
manner, namely:
(3) Government may co-opt any other Government functionary or sectoral expert as a Board Member
for a specific meeting as and when
need so arises. .

sections.shortTitle: The Pakhtunkhwa Energy Development Organization Amendment Act 2014

Amendment of section 5 of the Pakhtunkhwa Act No. I of 1993

AN
AN
ACT
further to amend the Pakhtunkhwa Hydel Development
Organization
Act, 1993
Preamble.--- WHEREAS it is expedient further to amend the Pakhtunkhwa Hydel Development Organization Act,
1993, (Pakhtunkhwa Act No. I of 1993)
for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:
5. Amendment of section 5 of the Pakhtunkhwa Act No. I of 1993.--- In the said Act, in section 5, for sub section (1), the following shall be substituted, namely:
(1) Government
shall appoint from private sector on attractive market based salary, an
established energy sector professional, preferably a bonafide resident of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Province having
prescribed experience as the Chief Executive
Officer of the Organization. .
